name: example-plugin
description: Reference plugin – demonstrates all BasePlugin features. Serves as a learning template and is excluded from release builds.
author: Tiktok2Mc

fields.label: Initial Count
fields.help: The starting value of the counter.

fields.label: Step Size
fields.help: How much the counter changes per increment/decrement.

fields.label: Auto Tick
fields.help: If enabled, the counter increments automatically every second.

fields.label: Maximum
fields.help: Upper limit of the counter (0 = unlimited).

fields.label: Colors (Theme)
fields.help: Overrides the plugin's default design colors.

fields.label: Text Color
fields.help: Main color for the counter text.
